summary:
Spotify第二季營收年增13.93%但EPS低於預期，整體表現穩健但獲利能力仍受檢視。
• 營收達到47.8億美元，較去年同期成長13.93%。
• 通訊服務板塊中的核心用戶與訂閱數持續展現韌性。
• 毛利率與獲利結構維持在健康水準，反映定價能力。
ai_view:
觀點：本季營收穩健但盈餘表現略顯疲軟，傳遞出成本控管與獲利轉化速度仍有待加強的訊號。對股價中短期而言可能帶來震盪整理壓力。未來需密切追蹤月活躍用戶數（MAU）成長、付費訂閱轉化率以及每用戶平均收入（ARPU）的變化。

需留意：每股盈餘未達市場預期，恐引發短期獲利能力疑慮。；宏觀經濟環境變動可能影響廣告收入與消費者訂閱意願。

summary_en:
Spotify reported Q2 revenue growth of 13.93% YoY with EPS missing estimates, showing steady top-line growth while profitability remains under scrutiny.
• Revenue reached $4.78B, representing a 13.93% YoY increase.
• Core user base and subscriber metrics demonstrated resilience within the communication services sector.
• Gross margins and profit structures remained healthy, reflecting strong pricing power.

ai_view_en:
View: The quarter showed solid revenue growth alongside soft earnings, signaling that cost control and profit conversion need further acceleration. This may induce near-to-mid-term consolidation pressure on the stock price. Key metrics to track include monthly active user (MAU) growth, premium subscriber conversion rates, and average revenue per user (ARPU).

Watch：EPS missing consensus estimates may raise short-term concerns regarding profitability.; Macroeconomic volatility could impact advertising revenue and consumer subscription willingness.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期，EPS為2.61美元低於市場預期的2.75美元。
